overview.description: The USCF Gold Strategy Plus Income Fund ETF (USG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in gold commodities. The fund is actively managed, aiming to provide gold exposure while generating income through a gold covered call writing strategy and collateral interest income. USG was launched on Nov 3, 2021 and is issued by Marygold.
